ZCZC HB13
071800 UTC SEP
GALE WARNING 118
BOTHNIAN SEA, ALAND SEA.
SOUTHWEST 8, INCREASING 9 DURING THE NIGHT. ROUGH OR VERY ROUGH SEA. VISIBILITY MODERATE IN RAIN.
VALID UNTIL 081200 UTC SEP.
NNNN
notes: Subject indicator B2 = B (meteorological warning) → MET_WARNING. Only sea-area names → geometry null, location_name carries the names for the gazetteer. 'Valid until' gives valid_to only; valid_from is not stated (the issue time is not silently copied into it).
